boundary.description: From the point where Astley Road crosses Wigan – Salford District boundary, S along Astley Road, Roscoe Road, Fairhills Road and by a bee-line to the Manchester Ship Canal. Then W along Salford – Trafford District boundary and N along Warrington – Salford District boundary and E along Wigan – Salford District boundary to the point where it crosses Astley Road.
